description: Use this when the user has chosen a vehicle from search_vehicles and explicitly agreed to book it. Creates a REAL booking with PRIVYDE through the same flow as privyde.com. Needs the passenger's real name, email and international phone: ask the user, never invent them. For the V300 Atelier it returns a secure Stripe page for the user to open: status payment_required (pay now) or card_required (save the card; nothing is charged yet and the amount is held closer to the service). The booking is confirmed only once that step is completed. For the Standard class and trips that need a person it returns request_received: a request the team confirms by email. Payment is never taken inside the chat and you must never ask for card details. Copy the trip object search_vehicles returned exactly (including serviceType) and pass expectedTotal with the price the user saw. Do not call it for trips search_vehicles returned without a price.

addons.description: Paid extras. Meet & Greet (welcome with a name board) is always included: do not pass it.

confirmed.description: true only after the user explicitly agreed to book this trip, vehicle and price.

date.description: Pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD, Madrid calendar date.

destination.description: Drop-off location. For a chauffeur at disposal (SRV_DISPOSITION) pass it ONLY if the service ends somewhere other than the Madrid region: it then adds the drive back to Madrid. If the service ends in Madrid, or the user only named the area where they will be, omit it and use dispositionArea.

dispositionArea.description: Main area or destination of an at-disposal service.

expectedTotal.description: The total in EUR the user saw in search_vehicles. Required for TIER_ATELIER. If the price changed, nothing is booked and the new price is returned.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

name.description: Full name of the passenger or the person booking.

oneWayOrRoundTrip.description: Always one_way: a round trip is booked as two one-way bookings (round_trip is rejected).

origin.description: Pickup location (address, airport terminal, hotel, station). Be specific: "Aeropuerto Madrid-Barajas T4", "Hotel Ritz Madrid".

phone.description: Mobile phone in international format, e.g. +34600000000.

serviceType.description: Optional: inferred when omitted (transfer or long distance from the route; disposal when hours/days are given).

termsAccepted.description: true only if the user accepted the terms on extras and cancellation, when search_vehicles says they are required (terms.required).

tier.description: Vehicle chosen by the user: TIER_ATELIER (Mercedes-Benz V300 Atelier, priced) or TIER_STANDARD (on request, no published price).

time.description: Pickup time, 24h HH:MM, Madrid wall-clock time.

yearConfirmed.description: Required when search_vehicles returned dateCheck (pickup more than 300 days ahead): true only after the user confirmed the year.
